name: Yakovlev Yak-55
summary: Single-seat Soviet competition aerobatic monoplane with a radial engine and fixed gear, built for tight, low-speed unlimited aerobatics.

wings: Mid-set straight monoplane wing with a thick symmetrical section
engines: Nine-cylinder Vedeneyev M-14P radial under a rounded cowl
fuselage: Single seat under a long sliding teardrop canopy reaching back to the wing trailing edge
Fixed sprung main gear and tailwheel
tail: Large fin and rudder on a tapering rear fuselage

tellTales: Single-seat radial-engined monoplane with a long teardrop canopy
Fixed (non-retracting) spring main gear with a mid-set wing
Rounded radial cowl on a small aerobatic airframe

confusedWith.howToTell: The Yak-50 is a low-wing single seater with retractable main wheels; the Yak-55 has fixed gear and a mid-set wing.
The Su-26 has a shorter canopy and wing fillets at the root; the Yak-55 has a longer teardrop canopy.
The Yak-52 has two seats and retractable tricycle gear; the Yak-55 is a single-seater with fixed taildragger gear.
